I liked how this video was finally honest at the end about what question it was really going to answer. I will give it to him, at least he's honest about his biases and his convoluted approach to eventually provide the right context for the correct answer to work. That said, I find his approach to be negatively intellectually manipulative especially when there are so many other upfront, less rage-baity sources out there. My response to his conclusion would be, while it might be a grammatical or ever logical misattribution error by those who lose their jobs (or just those who know better) the effect is the same even if the exact cause is slightly different. A lot of people will suffer because the markets or governments or they themselves are somehow trapped because one or more of those tiers are too slow to keep up with the exponential rate of change. While I feel like you might be near the head of the pack in this race, at the rate this change is coming, it will catch up with you as well, and the of acknowledgement of that non-zero probability is the one common theme loudly missing from all your videos. Good luck to you.
